obj/fetch-the-fireworks.text: The storeroom is stacked to the rafters with rockets. Bernt, at your elbow, says 'Oh, good,' in a voice that means he had given up.

on_complete.text: Night. The whole town comes up the main street to the square, and the festival begins.

obj/back-to-the-stage.text: A horn from the bay. Three low boats with striped sails: raiders, come for the festival and, says Hedda, very specifically for the cake.
Bernt has carted the castle's crossbows down to the stage with whatever rockets the day saved. 'Load the rocket where the bolt goes. Point it at the boats. Not at the cake.'

on_respawn.text: You come round on a bench in the inn's taproom across the square. Somebody has left you a pie.

happening.subject: wave/dock-landing
happening.text: The first raiders land at the quay.

obj/hold-the-beach.text: A bigger horn. A man in a hat with a feather that could take an eye out stands up in the last boat and points at the cake.

happening.subject: wave/the-captain

effects.text: The lighthouse beam swings round and holds: boats running up on the beach past the harbour! Thirty breaths away.

barks: Sixty-one festivals, and every one of them went wrong somewhere. That is how you know it is the festival.

barks: Mind the stairs. The stairs do not mind you.
Three goats, and one of them is the problem.
The cake is resting. Do not slam any doors near the cake.
Six crates of the feast in the bay. Row gently. Crates are shy.
By-law fourteen: the bell rings at dusk. By-law fourteen did not foresee the rope.

objectives.title: Tell Hedda to begin

on_complete.text: The lighthouse beam sweeps over the square, and every face turns up into it as it passes.
The lighthouse stays dark, so Hedda reads her speech by a lantern Oskar holds up for her, and gets most of it right.
On the stroke of midnight the festival bell rings the festival in.
Halfway through Hedda's speech, Vidar finally gets the bell to ring, and the whole square cheers the interruption.
Oskar's cake stands on the stage, four tiers and a sugar lighthouse, without a mark on it.
Hedda gives the toast to the cake's empty plate, and the town toasts the plate.

happening.subject: npc/hedda
happening.text: Kelderby holds its festival, made of whatever the day managed.

on_complete.text: The castle's fireworks fill the whole sky over the town, and keep filling it until the dogs give up barking.
A few rockets go up, one after another, a polite gap between each. The town cheers every one of them, individually.

state.note: Arrows the party has put in the belfry target; three free the rope's knot.
1 while the forecourt bell is still humming from its last ring at dusk; it can be rung again at 0.

How many vindicators stand on the stage by the cake.

effects.text: Through the spyglass: on the castle road, a fox trotting uphill with something bright in its mouth. Inga squints up the stair: 'That's Bernt's storeroom key. The fireworks are locked in there.'
Thock. The rope's knot jumps on the target.

answers.done: The fox has nothing left to give you but a look.
answers.not_yet: The fox shies away from your hand and keeps its prize.

effects.text: The fox considers you for a long moment, then opens its mouth and lets you take the key. It looks offended.

answers.not_yet: The bell is still humming. Give it a moment.

effects.text: The bell booms, and every raider in the town lights up like a lantern.
A raider bounds onto the stage, snatches Oskar's cake and is gone with it into the dusk.
